subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Goods and Services Tax (GST), which replaced multiple indirect taxes in India, was implemented from:
explanation: GST was rolled out across India from 1 July 2017, unifying central and state indirect taxes like VAT, excise duty and service tax into a single tax system.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch25 — Economy — Deep Practice
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), launched in 2014, primarily aims to:

options.option_text: Provide universal access to banking facilities for every household
Provide free higher education to all students
Provide employment guarantee in rural areas

explanation: PMJDY is a financial-inclusion scheme ensuring access to bank accounts, insurance and credit for unbanked households. Rural roads fall under PMGSY; employment guarantee under MGNREGA.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch25 — Economy — Deep Practice
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: In India, retail inflation is officially measured using the:
explanation: CPI measures retail/consumer-level price changes and is the RBI's key reference for monetary policy (inflation targeting). WPI measures wholesale-level prices; the Sensex is a stock market index, unrelated to inflation.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch25 — Economy — Deep Practice
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Union Budget of India is presented in Parliament each year by the:

options.option_text: Prime Minister always, regardless of portfolio

explanation: The Finance Minister presents the Union Budget in the Lok Sabha, typically on 1 February. The RBI Governor heads the central bank, not the fiscal budget process; the President addresses the joint session separately at the start of the session.
